name: core.openwop.workflows.feedback-triage
description: Feedback-triage chains (RFC 0013): turn raw inbound feedback into classified, routed, actionable items. A form submission is classified and (on approval) filed as a follow-up task; a batch is themed into a weekly digest. Replay-deterministic.
author: openwop

chains.label: Feedback → Classify → Task
chains.description: Every feedback form submission is classified (theme, sentiment, severity) by AI; a human confirms, and a CRM follow-up task is filed with the classification.

orgId.description: Org the follow-up task belongs to.

theme.description: Default theme label for the task title.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

config.systemPrompt: Classify this product feedback: theme (bug / feature-request / usability / pricing / praise / other), sentiment (positive / neutral / negative), severity (low / normal / high). Return a one-line rationale. Do not invent details beyond the text.

config.title: Confirm the classification before filing a task

chains.label: Weekly Feedback → Theme Digest
chains.description: A scheduled roll-up that clusters the week's feedback into the top recurring themes with representative quotes, then posts the digest as an in-app notification.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

scheduleCron.description: Cron expression for when this workflow runs (e.g. `0 9 * * 1` = Mondays 09:00).

config.systemPrompt: You are a product analyst. Cluster this week's feedback into the top 3-5 recurring themes. For each: a title, a one-line summary, an approximate count, and one representative verbatim quote. Rank by volume. Ground every theme in the provided items.
